gloss_en: the revelation of the Divine Will (hitgalut ha-ratzon) — the event/state in Likutey Moharan II:4 in which the 'Forehead of Will' (metzach ha-ratzon) is disclosed after the Forehead of the Serpent (natural wisdom) is subdued, and which in turn generates fear/awe (yirah); i.e., 'when the Will is revealed'
